dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: So this is where you usually stay? It's so spacious! This is making me jealous.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: If only I could use the "abode" arts of the Liyue Adepti on the Golden Beagle...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's great! I don't have to worry about the wind or rain, or where my next meal is coming from — and the scenery is amazing! Thanks for inviting me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm glad you like it.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're so nice! Can I ask a teeny tiny favor, though?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ask away.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Is it okay if I set up camp here? I'll find a spot that's out of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? So... you don't like your room?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: No, no, no, it's lovely! Everything's so comfy and cozy, the bed's warm and dry, and it smells nice too. It's so much nicer than the rooms at The Flagship, I'll tell you that...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's just... Ah, well, they say it's easy to go from rags to riches, but much harder to go back again.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: If I get used to this life, I'm worried I won't be able to return to living off the land...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: What if I find myself dreaming about this fluffy bed while I'm deep in the mountains? I'm not sure I could cope!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: For someone like me, I think it's best to maintain a healthy hunger for the finer things in life.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That way, I can make sure my senses are sharp while never losing the drive and excitement to pursue what I want.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: For me, that's the crux of living.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see, so that's your survival strategy...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Indeed! So, if it's alright with you, I'd like to set up my own camp somewhere out of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Out of interest, have you ever stopped to listen to the music of the night? The nighttime wilds are far from silent, and thickets that appear like shadows are actually hives of nocturnal activity.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Some insects only sing when moonlight bathes the stage, chirping and chiming one after another as if following some mysterious tune.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Listening to them sing is fascinating. If that sounds like something you'd like to hear, feel free to drop by my camp sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Or we can just lie there and gaze at the stars. That would be nice too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have time for a chat?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Sure. Found anything interesting on your recent adventures?

choices.text: I found some more treasure chests...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Oh, that's wonderful! For us adventurers, there's no better way to pay the bills than finding a chest or two!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Take me. If I relied solely on my income as a consultant for the Adventurers' Guild, who knows how long it would take to save up for my own research vessel...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: However, I have to be careful when opening chests to make sure Lumi doesn't swallow whatever's inside.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I really don't know where she picked up this habit of swallowing every shiny thing she sees.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Though come to think of it... There is a legend about Crystal Beetles that says they started carrying solid Phlogiston around as a way to make themselves stand out...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: So maybe the reason Lumi swallows shiny things isn't because she's hungry...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: ...But rather because she's collecting decorations, hoping to wear them one day and be accepted by the other Jack Frosts.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I'll make sure to feed her more next time! It's just a few chunks of ore, after all. As long as I keep finding more chests, I can always replace them later.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Ruins that rarely see visitors tend to develop their own unique ecosystems. They're truly fascinating places!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: That said, the traps and monsters inside aren't quite so charming...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Things like Primal Constructs and Secret Source Automatons aren't much of an issue, but Clockwork Meka... Ugh, just thinking about them sends shivers down my spine.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: The Fontaine Research Institute is such a terrifying place... To think they created so many of those things, all with their own different functions...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: But I must admit, the dance of Coppelia and Coppelius is truly captivating, like watching a performance on the stage... though I made sure to enjoy it from a distance.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, do you prefer the Icewind Suite or Knuckle Duckle?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Knuckle Duckle, of course! It's so much cuter, and can even handle basic conversations. Besides, if pressed, I'd say it's not entirely without its practical applications.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: But most importantly, Aino invented it...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: What are you laughing at? So what if I'm biased towards my friends?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, I'd quite like to record my discoveries here in my encyclopedia.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: When I was chatting with Tubby earlier, she even gave me a feather. Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, if Tubby's okay with it...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry, I already asked! I always make sure to get permission, as long as the subject is someone I can talk to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what if they're not?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: W—Well, in that case... I guess I'd figure it out on the fly?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, the times I tracked that Rishboland Tiger and those water birds in Sumeru were really dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Rishboland Tigers are highly territorial, so I set up camp some distance away from its den to allow for easier observation.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Apparently, the fur on a Rishboland Tiger's temples allows it to measure distances. I wanted to verify this claim... but unfortunately, I got a little too close.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Racing a Rishboland Tiger through the jungle really isn't something I'd recommend, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: If it weren't for a passing Forest Ranger coming to my rescue, I might not have made it out alive...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But thanks to that experience, I also learned about a special rainforest fungus whose spores are the bane of the Rishboland Tiger.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: And with that, another page was added to my encyclopedia. So, I guess you could call it a blessing in disguise!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess... but how did chasing after water birds land you in danger?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Well, it wasn't the water birds themselves that were dangerous, but rather the environment they live in.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Lumi and I were in a small boat watching them build nests in their wetland habitat. They would pick up floating twigs and branches to use as nesting material.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But clearly, besides us, there were other animals that had figured out their nesting habits.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Those floating branches were actually traps. These other animals would wait for the water birds to wade out and pick them up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, so there were Spinocrocodiles... I shouldn't be surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Exactly! A huge Spinocrocodile suddenly leaped out of the water, and the waves it created almost capsized our boat.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That noise alerted other Spinocrocodiles nearby, and somehow, they ended up deciding that Lumi and I would make even better prey...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Luckily, they're not as agile on land as they are in water. Once we made it to dry ground, they stopped chasing us.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: So if you're ever planning on going birdwatching in the wetlands, watch out for the dangers in the water too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's certainly a valuable lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Right? I don't want to toot my own horn, but my lectures for fresh-faced adventurers are really quite popular.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you considered turning them into picture books?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Those little educational picture books for kids? I've never considered that before...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But it's not a bad idea! The children in the Conch Gang can't get enough of my stories. Maybe I have a special talent? Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Besides, if I can get published, the royalties would go a long way...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Yeah! There's no time to lose... Let's get started right away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Linnea.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Good morning! I've already been for a walk with Lumi. You should give it a try too, it really clears the mind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Linnea.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's been a long day, and it's time for some rest. We need to be fully charged for whatever adventures tomorrow may bring!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Good night, and sweet dreams!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Wow, every plant and tree here is like an old friend. I couldn't feel more at home!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: On childhood adventures, I never strayed too far. I would imagine Thornback Geckos were colossal dragons and play with them while wondering why their spines glowed.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Thinking back on it now, perhaps my curiosity with all things great and small began back then.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It was quite a shock when I first left the Conch Gang to strike out on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Leaving such a lively collective to live all alone, it was hard not to feel a little lonely... Thankfully, now I have Lumi, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: By the way, don't tell anyone in the Conch Gang I said that. I don't want them knowing how uncertain their old boss was.
